status: BENCHMARK - owner to confirm before publish
method: PDF ranges are the owner's draft numbers. Public price points were retrieved 2026-09-25 from Ontario installer, contractor, manufacturer and aggregator pages; where they disagree with the PDF, low/high keep the PDF values and suggested_low/suggested_high carry the corroborated band. See claims-register.md, claim 10.

rows.typical_shaft: 2.0 to 2-3/8 in (50 to 60 mm) round shaft; source: technometalpost.com FAQ (2.0 in minimum for decks) and CCMC 13059-R shaft diameters 47.6 mm and 60.3 mm; owner to confirm for their system
rows.typical_capacity_lb: over 6,000 per 2.0 in pile (technometalpost.com FAQ); larger figures null until the owner's CCMC report torque table is cited
rows.basis: PDF benchmark; public corroboration: Toronto installers and aggregators quote $300-$500 for deck piles (citywidepostdigging.ca $300-$600 all residential; gamcon.ca decks ~$300-$500; screwpilesquotes.ca decks $300-$500; thepostholediggers.ca from $350). Postech manufacturer FAQ $150-$300 is the low outlier with currency unstated.
rows.label: Deck or porch

rows.typical_shaft: 2-7/8 to 3.5 in (73 to 89 mm) round shaft; source: AC358 default Kt shaft sizes 2.875, 3.0, 3.5 in and CCMC 13059-R 88.9 mm shaft; owner to confirm for their system
rows.capacity_note: No public per-pile capacity figure retrieved for addition-class piles; cite the owner's CCMC report torque table before publishing a number.
rows.basis: PDF benchmark; public corroboration is LOWER: gamcon.ca additions/sunrooms ~$400-$700 and screwpilesquotes.ca (Toronto) additions/sunrooms $400-$700; screwpilesquotes.ca London ON $300-$650 with ~$500 typical. Techno Metal Post says addition piles cost 'a few hundred dollars'. Extensions beyond 7 ft add $15-$30 per foot (gamcon.ca).
rows.suggestion_reason: Both Toronto sources that split out additions give $400-$700; the PDF's $575-$875 has no public support above $700. Owner to confirm what a 'heavy' pile includes (shaft size, extensions, engineering) or adopt the suggested band.
rows.label: Addition or sunroom

rows.typical_shaft: 2-7/8 to 3.5 in round shaft with repair (Type A) or direct-load (Type B) bracket per AC358 section 3.10; source: ICC-ES ESR-4735 bracket definitions; owner to confirm for their system
rows.capacity_note: No public per-pier capacity figure retrieved; cite the engineer's design or the system's evaluation report.
rows.basis: PDF benchmark; public points straddle it: gamcon.ca and screwpilesquotes.ca (Toronto) say underpinning piles run '$800+' per pile; foundationfix.ca (Southern Ontario foundation-repair contractor, 2025-10-30) says helical piers '$2,000 to $5,000 per pier' for full repair scope, plus structural engineer report $800-$2,500.
rows.suggestion_reason: The PDF ceiling of $1,650+ is below the lowest full-scope figure published by an Ontario foundation-repair contractor ($2,000 per pier). Raising the published ceiling to $2,000 keeps the range honest until the owner states whether excavation, bracket and engineering are included.
rows.label: Underpinning (pile and bracket)

volume_note: Public sources say per-pile cost 'could drop based on volume' (screwpilesquotes.ca) and suggest grouping with neighbours for a discount (screwpilesquotes.ca London ON). No source states an 8-pile threshold; the PDF's 'volume discount at 8+ piles' is the owner's policy and needs the owner's written price schedule before it publishes. Until then say 'volume pricing on larger pile counts'.
mobilization_note: Public GTA installers publish minimum charges rather than folding them into per-pile prices: thepostholediggers.ca minimums $400-$800 by area (Oakville, Milton, Georgetown $650); gamcon.ca cites a downtown Toronto mobilization minimum of about $800. Show a mobilization or minimum-job line on the pricing page.
excluded_note: What typically pushes price up: rock/shale drilling or pre-drilling, no gate access (hand-carried or portable equipment), high loads (larger shaft, more helices, extensions at $15-$30 per foot beyond about 7 ft per gamcon.ca), travel and mobilization minimums, frozen ground (auger pre-drill or thaw per technometalpost.com), engineering and permit fees ($100-$500 per screwpilesquotes.ca; engineer's report $800-$2,500 per foundationfix.ca).

illustrative_note: Illustrative ranges only. Each site carries its own conditions: soil, access, loads and travel all move the number. The firm price is the written quote after a site review.
included_note: Owner to confirm what the per-pile price includes (bracket, mobilization, torque log, engineer's certificate). Until then the ranges are shown as installed price per pile with engineering and permit fees listed separately.
deck_post_spacing_basis: Illustrative layout rule for the estimator only: posts about every 8 ft along each beam, beam lines about every 8 ft across the depth; a ledger-attached deck carries one side on the house. Owner or engineer to confirm; the drawings govern every real layout.
